detail.longDescription: LINUXexpert is done for now: study guides for 48 certification exams, from Linux and Kubernetes to AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and GitHub. 39 have timed practice exams that run like the testing center. The 12 hands-on exams (LFCS, CKA, CKS, RHCSA and more) have lab exams on real machines, made when you start, deleted when you finish. No fake terminal. Guides and a practice exam a day come with an account. Labs need the plan, $12/mo. https:// coffeylabs.org/news/linuxexper t-48-exams/ # Linux # Kubernetes # CloudNative
